# GuruWalk

> GuruWalk is a global marketplace for free walking tours and paid activities, connecting independent local guides ("gurus") with travelers in 1,000+ cities across 120+ countries. Free tours have no fixed price: booking is free and takes a minute, can be cancelled at no cost, and travelers tip the guide what they feel the tour was worth ("pay what you feel").

Key facts:

- Paid activities with fixed prices: day trips, guided tours, food tours, boat tours, night tours and wine tours.
- Website languages: English (default, no URL prefix), Spanish (/es), Italian (/it), German (/de).

## How it works

- [What is GuruWalk](https://support.guruwalk.com/portal/en/kb/articles/what-is-guruwalk): the free tour model explained
- [Traveler help center](https://support.guruwalk.com/portal/en/kb): booking, cancellations, meeting points, tipping
- [Become a guide](https://www.guruwalk.com/work-free-tour-guide): publish your own tours as a local guide

## For AI agents

- [MCP server](https://back.guruwalk.com/mcp): read-only — search destinations, browse tours and activities, check real-time availability; bookings complete on the website. Listed in the Anthropic and ChatGPT connector directories.
- [MCP documentation](https://ai.guruwalk.com/docs/walkers): tools, examples and setup guides
- [AI catalog](https://www.guruwalk.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): machine-readable capability discovery
- [Entity map](https://www.guruwalk.com/entitymap.json): entity graph of destinations and tours
